description: Add a prior-decision reconciliation step to review-shaped actions on plans. Before judging steps, enumerate the recorded decision surfaces the plan's scope touches: future-state index and priority tiers, migration gates in design docs, readiness/evidence documents, and open tracker items at the relevant priority. The plan must cite each one or explicitly supersede it. Treat an unexplained demotion of recorded priority, or a dropped open gate, as a plan defect. Do not replace claim-against-code checking; add this as a parallel axis.

verifications.description: Protocol requires citing or superseding recorded decisions
